summary: ADR-0057 accepted 2026-08-05; knowledge publication owned only by maintain-knowledge-base via separate append-only request with explicit maintainer confirmation; request binds caller, trigger, one target plan, pinned local main commit, non-automatic status, timestamp, knowledge-publication authority, and hash-verified stale maintenance route; target must exist at pinned main and publish_knowledge_catalog.py --publish fails closed without bindings; Acceptance emits typed hash-bound non-authorizing stale stop route persisted append-only in target plan; VDD/Acceptance restrict outputs to exact declared target directory; global catalog indexes stable semantic plan sources only, excluding authority manifests and knowledge contexts; standalone builder read-only, formal layers/pointers activated only by publication gate with validated capability; versioned top-level requirements, implementation contract, plan state, command registry files select highest numeric version and support requirements-ledger/requirements names; historical generations remain readable without retroactive request field; extends ADR-0044/0048/0050; breaks recursive freshness loop and prevents sibling-plan mutation.
